10.1016/j.talanta.2026.130241.summary: Reviewed 129 studies on label-free surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) for microbial sensing. The review traced six stages from sample preparation to validation and found external testing in only 6.2% of studies.
10.1016/j.talanta.2026.130241.contribution: I designed the review, led the evidence synthesis and validation audit, and prepared the figures, tables, and manuscript.

10.1016/j.bspc.2026.109894.summary: Developed a CT pipeline that narrows the search to kidney and stone slices before segmentation. On the study cohort, Dice was 97.44% with scope reduction and 90.13% when that step was omitted.
10.1016/j.bspc.2026.109894.contribution: I designed the scope-reduction and feature-transfer strategy and led model development, evaluation, analysis, and writing.

10.1016/j.talanta.2025.129332.summary: Used analyte-enriched blood spectra and super-operational neural networks to recognise sepsis and identify pathogens. The study included an independent external cohort of 70 samples.
10.1016/j.talanta.2025.129332.contribution: I developed the workflow from raw spectra through preprocessing, split design, model training, evaluation, and interpretation. I also helped document the experimental protocol.

10.1016/j.rser.2025.116481.summary: Reviewed deep reinforcement learning across generation, storage, grid operations, and energy markets. The review mapped algorithms to operating problems and examined barriers to deployment, including safety and transfer from simulation.
10.1016/j.rser.2025.116481.contribution: I led the review design, literature synthesis, taxonomy, comparative analysis, visualisations, and writing.

10.1016/j.saa.2025.126931.summary: Mapped SERS spectra from four portable instruments to a laboratory reference and evaluated bacterial classification after alignment. The study also examined how many reference spectra were needed for adaptation.
10.1016/j.saa.2025.126931.contribution: I led development and evaluation of the spectral alignment and classification models and prepared the analysis, figures, and manuscript.

10.1109/jbhi.2025.3605296.summary: Reconstructed three-dimensional ground reaction forces, moments, and centre of pressure from distributed insole pressures. The study used instrumented-treadmill references and participant-held-out evaluation.
10.1109/jbhi.2025.3605296.contribution: I led preprocessing, development and evaluation of Ke2KeNet, and manuscript preparation. I also analysed which plantar regions carried the most useful information.

10.1016/j.jobe.2025.113731.summary: Paired appliance-level load disaggregation with occupancy detection from multichannel smart-meter data. A cascaded model evaluated how individual device events could help infer occupancy on the ECO dataset.
10.1016/j.jobe.2025.113731.contribution: I led study design, data curation, software development, validation, analysis, visualisation, and writing.

10.1007/s00521-025-11327-x.summary: Evaluated whether distant radar could recover continuous beat-to-beat arterial blood pressure waveforms from raw in-phase and quadrature signals across recording scenarios.
10.1007/s00521-025-11327-x.contribution: I proposed investigating one-dimensional signal reconstruction for this task and contributed to model implementation, evaluation, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.1007/s00521-025-11348-6.summary: Encoded environmental sensor time series as images to estimate indoor occupancy. The study evaluated a tailored convolutional network across three benchmark datasets.
10.1007/s00521-025-11348-6.contribution: I redesigned the occupancy classifier and contributed to the experimental setup, analysis, and manuscript.

10.1016/j.buildenv.2025.112635.summary: Combined appliance-event, statistical, and time-of-day features to infer occupancy from smart meters. The study evaluated feature fusion, ensemble classifiers, and device selection on the ECO dataset.
10.1016/j.buildenv.2025.112635.contribution: I led conceptualisation, data curation, methodology, software development, analysis, visualisation, and original drafting.

10.1007/s11517-025-03311-3.summary: Predicted wall shear stress in abdominal aortic aneurysms by representing three-dimensional geometries from multiple views. The study compared model outputs with computational fluid dynamics estimates on real and synthetic geometries.
10.1007/s11517-025-03311-3.contribution: I contributed to model implementation and integration, iterative evaluation, and troubleshooting with the modelling team.

10.1016/j.bspc.2024.107233.summary: Restored wrist photoplethysmography (PPG) with a one-dimensional CycleGAN and tested whether restoration improved atrial fibrillation detection across two test splits.

10.1016/j.mtcomm.2024.110932.summary: Compared six hip-stem materials under walking, standing, and sitting loads using finite element simulations. The study examined stress transfer, stress shielding, and implant micromovement.

10.1109/access.2024.3412274.summary: Used four-channel vibration data to identify gearbox faults with a lightweight one-dimensional network, evaluated against ResNet baselines.
10.1109/access.2024.3412274.contribution: I contributed to model evaluation and analysis, interpreted the results, and reviewed the manuscript.

10.1109/access.2024.3404971.summary: Combined PPG, blood pressure, and demographic data to estimate glucose and classify diabetes severity in a 139-participant study. The regression evaluation included Clarke Error Grid analysis.
10.1109/access.2024.3404971.contribution: I contributed to machine-learning and physiological-signal analysis, technical evaluation, and manuscript review.

10.1016/j.compbiomed.2024.108555.summary: Reconstructed ECG waveforms from contactless radar with a multiresolution network, evaluating performance during rest, the Valsalva manoeuvre, and apnoea.
10.1016/j.compbiomed.2024.108555.contribution: I contributed to methodology, model development, quantitative evaluation, and original drafting.

10.1016/j.engappai.2024.108483.summary: Evaluated two methods for recovering 12-lead ECG and R-peak timing from magnetohydrodynamic distortion in MRI at 1, 3, and 7 tesla.

10.1109/access.2024.3390566.summary: Built and tested a portable negative-pressure ventilation prototype with continuous and cyclic operation, closed-loop pressure control, and emergency safety mechanisms.
10.1109/access.2024.3390566.contribution: I supported engineering analysis and prototype evaluation, interpreted test results, and helped write and revise the paper.

10.1016/j.eswa.2024.124594.summary: Combined kidney localisation, segmentation, and multi-view ultrasound classification to estimate prenatal hydronephrosis severity. The study evaluated grading at the subject level for 164 subjects.

10.1109/access.2024.3353463.summary: Reconstructed ECG from wearable measurements of cardiac vibration and rotation. The study evaluated waveform similarity and whether heart rate could be recovered on held-out participants.
10.1109/access.2024.3353463.contribution: I contributed to methodology, data analysis, model evaluation, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.1016/j.wasman.2023.12.014.summary: Classified recyclable waste from images for both single-label and multi-label tasks. The study evaluated the method on the 25,000-image GIGO dataset and used Score-CAM to inspect which regions influenced predictions.
10.1016/j.wasman.2023.12.014.contribution: I helped develop the deep-learning framework and contributed to evaluation, experimental analysis, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.1016/j.engappai.2023.107514.summary: Used an attention-guided operational CycleGAN to restore motion-corrupted EEG. Evaluation on held-out participants examined signal recovery in the time and frequency domains.

10.1016/j.bspc.2023.105687.summary: Estimated contactless PPG waveforms from facial video using a shallow encoder-decoder. The evaluation compared both waveform fidelity and agreement of derived heart rates.

10.3390/s23218890.summary: Benchmarked 24 architectures for liver segmentation in T1-weighted MRI. The study also evaluated a cascaded segmentation approach and described a workflow for cloud-based model updates.
10.3390/s23218890.contribution: I contributed to software implementation, data curation, original drafting, and manuscript revision.

10.1007/s00521-023-09081-z.summary: Estimated three-dimensional ground reaction forces and moments from five shoe-mounted motion markers. The study evaluated the attention-guided model across two public gait datasets.

10.3390/cancers15123189.summary: Combined CT-derived features with clinical records to classify renal tumours and estimate the surgical approach in the study cohort. Feature analysis identified tumour volume and cancer stage as informative.

10.3390/diagnostics13122000.summary: Classified abnormal middle cerebral artery blood-flow velocity from transcranial Doppler ultrasound waveforms using an attention-based residual network.

10.1016/j.engappai.2023.106414.summary: Used a deeply supervised LinkNet++ to recover fetal ECG from maternal recordings. Leave-one-subject-out evaluation on two datasets assessed waveform fidelity and fetal QRS timing.

10.1016/j.engappai.2023.106130.summary: Used a convolutional variational autoencoder with LSTM features to identify unusual resting heart rate patterns in smartwatch records. The study examined anomalies before and after symptom onset in a cohort of 68 people with COVID-19.

10.3390/bioengineering10050542.summary: Detected ECG R peaks under magnetohydrodynamic distortion from MRI. The study evaluated an attention-based detector on 3- and 7-tesla recordings.
10.3390/bioengineering10050542.contribution: I contributed to methodology, software development, validation, and manuscript drafting and revision.

10.3389/fped.2023.1149318.summary: Estimated penile curvature from images of nine 3D models. The pipeline localised and segmented the models and derived the curvature angle from their masks.

10.1016/j.bspc.2023.104882.summary: Combined generative waveform enhancement with a two-stream classifier to distinguish abnormal middle cerebral artery flow from transcranial Doppler recordings.

10.1007/s10489-023-04557-w.summary: Combined ground reaction force waveforms and gait-cycle features to distinguish healthy gait from gait patterns associated with Parkinson’s disease, Huntington’s disease, and ALS in a 64-participant dataset.

10.3390/ma16041466.summary: Simulated a spiral trunnion at the head-stem interface of a hip implant. The study compared predicted wear, sliding distance, and fixation stability with a conventional design.
10.3390/ma16041466.contribution: I designed the spiral geometry in Fusion 360 and contributed to the finite element methodology, implementation, and analysis.

10.1016/j.sna.2022.114092.summary: Built a fibre Bragg grating insole to measure plantar pressure and temperature simultaneously. Static and gait experiments evaluated the prototype and its real-time pressure and temperature maps.
10.1016/j.sna.2022.114092.contribution: I led system development and evaluation, data collection and analysis, validation, and manuscript preparation.

10.3390/bios13010079.summary: Modelled a surface acoustic wave sensor for detecting hip implant loosening. Finite element simulations compared voltage response and stress at two implant locations under three loading conditions.
10.3390/bios13010079.contribution: I contributed to simulation software, investigation, and formal analysis.

10.1007/s00521-022-08111-6.summary: Removed motion artefacts from single-channel EEG with a multiresolution reconstruction network. Leave-one-subject-out evaluation assessed signal recovery on held-out participants.

10.3390/bioengineering9110692.summary: Translated PPG into arterial blood pressure waveforms with two cascaded networks. The evaluation measured waveform error and errors in derived systolic, diastolic, and mean arterial pressure.

10.3390/bioengineering9100558.summary: Estimated respiration rate directly from PPG with a compact ConvMixer network. The study evaluated two public datasets and tested limited fine-tuning across datasets.
10.3390/bioengineering9100558.contribution: I contributed to data curation, technical analysis, and manuscript review.

10.3390/polym14204308.contribution: I contributed to the computational and technical analysis and helped design and prepare figures for the review.

10.3390/s22197599.summary: Built a wireless insole prototype with 16 pressure sensors and eight temperature sensors per insole. The system displayed plantar pressure and temperature maps in real time.
10.3390/s22197599.contribution: I contributed to methodology, experimental investigation, and manuscript review.

10.1016/j.compbiomed.2022.105682.summary: Modelled resting heart rate with an LSTM variational autoencoder to identify anomalies in wearable data around COVID-19 symptom onset. The study examined how its evaluation setup affected the balance between precision and recall.
10.1016/j.compbiomed.2022.105682.contribution: I contributed to wearable-data analysis, model evaluation, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.3390/diagnostics12040920.summary: Compared cough and breath audio for classifying COVID-19 in symptomatic and asymptomatic groups and integrated the classification workflow into an application prototype.
10.3390/diagnostics12040920.contribution: I contributed to technical analysis and validation of the audio pipeline, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.3390/s22030919.contribution: I led study design, data curation, methodology, implementation, validation, analysis, visualisation, and writing.

10.1016/j.compbiomed.2021.105184.contribution: I contributed to gait-data analysis, classical machine-learning evaluation, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.1109/access.2022.3173424.summary: Localised hip implants on X-rays and assessed aseptic loosening with a classification pipeline. The authors released the annotated radiography dataset used in the study.
10.1109/access.2022.3173424.contribution: I contributed to pipeline development and evaluation, data analysis, interpretation, and manuscript writing and review.

10.1016/j.compbiomed.2021.105002.summary: Segmented lungs and infection regions in chest radiographs to localise COVID-19 pneumonia and estimate the extent of involvement for severity grading.
10.1016/j.compbiomed.2021.105002.contribution: I helped curate the benchmark dataset and contributed to dataset and model evaluation, interpretation, and manuscript review.

10.3390/diagnostics11050893.summary: Segmented lungs and infection regions in chest CT scans, then used the extent of involvement to classify COVID-19 severity.

10.1080/10911359.2021.1973642.summary: Used survey responses from Qatar residents to model vaccine attitudes and examine factors associated with willingness and hesitancy.
10.1080/10911359.2021.1973642.contribution: I contributed to quantitative and machine-learning analysis, interpretation, and manuscript preparation and review.

10.1007/978-981-97-3302-6_3.contribution: I contributed to technical analysis, interpretation of the results, and manuscript review.

10.5121/csit.2022.122001.summary: Benchmarked 21 pretrained convolutional encoders on chest radiographs to distinguish COVID-19, viral pneumonia, bacterial pneumonia, and normal images.
